product: Bioprocessing consumables and systems across Filtration and Fluid Management, Chromatography including OPUS pre-packed columns, Process Analytics and Proteins, sold to biopharma and CDMOs; Q2 2026 revenue 204 million dollars, up 13 pct organic (2026-07-28). BioLife adds CryoStor biopreservation media for cell therapy, used in 18 approved therapies (2026-07-22).
demand: Predominantly volume, with mix help. Q2 2026 revenue of 204 million dollars rose 12 pct reported and 13 pct organic, gross margin 53.9 pct and adjusted operating margin 16.7 pct (2026-07-28); management cited order momentum continuing from Q1 2026 and portfolio diversification, not pricing. No evidence of price-led growth or disclosed price increases.
pricing_power: GAAP operating margin is already thin at 6.8 pct in Q2 2026 versus 7.6 pct a year earlier (2026-07-28), with SG&A up to 76.6M dollars, a 2.3M dollar contingent-consideration charge, a 13.7M dollar divestiture loss and 5.7M dollars interest. Further mix shift, BioLife integration and inventory step-up costs, or missed synergies would compress margins.
competition: Partly. Repligen signed a China OEM partnership, disclosed 2026-05-05, to gain local manufacturing and competitiveness, an admission that lower-cost local supply is a competitive factor. Domestic Chinese chromatography resins, filtration and cell-culture media are the substitutes; how close they are is not found in primary sources.
market_strategy: CEO Olivier Loeillot on 2026-07-28 raised FY26 guidance to 10.5-13.5 pct organic growth and adjusted EPS of 2.03 to 2.09 dollars, from 9-13 pct and 1.97 to 2.05 on 2026-05-05. On 2026-07-22 he promised the BioLife deal would be accretive at least 0.05 dollars year one and 0.25 dollars year two and close in Q4 2026.
bull: Q2 2026 revenue $204M up 13% organic, adjusted EPS $0.54 beat $0.45, FY26 guidance raised to 10.5-13.5% organic (2026-07-28 8-K); BioLife deal HSR-cleared 2026-09-03, vote set 2026-10-05, promised accretive $0.05 year one.
bear: GAAP operating margin only 6.8% vs 7.6% a year earlier, SG&A $76.6M, divestiture loss $13.7M (2026-07-28); BioLife accretion and $20M synergies unproven until close; 64% stock deal dilutes; China OEM admits low-cost substitute pressure.
falsifier: BioLife stockholders fail to adopt the merger at the 2026-10-05 special meeting, or Q3 2026 GAAP operating margin (due ~2026-10-27) stays near 6.8% with no accretion line of sight.
web_what_changed_30_90d: Last 90 days: 2026-07-21/22 definitive agreement to acquire BioLife Solutions for about 1.5B dollars (11.25 cash plus 0.1442 RGEN shares, 31.00 per share, 64 pct stock) per SEC 8-K; 2026-07-28 Q2 revenue 204M dollars, up 13 pct organic, FY26 guidance raised; 2026-09-03 HSR cleared; 2026-09-09 UBS PT to 225 dollars. Last 30 days: no new financial filing, only 2026-09-10 board retirement of Karen Dawes.
web_true_now_not_modelled: Deal is one step from closing: HSR waiting period expired 2026-09-03 and the Form S-4 became effective 2026-09-04 (SEC 8-K 2026-09-08), leaving only the BioLife stockholder vote set for 2026-10-05. Meanwhile GAAP operating margin is still only 6.8 pct in Q2 2026 versus adjusted 16.7 pct (2026-07-28), so GAAP EPS understates the model.
web_demand_product: Bioprocessing consumables and systems across Filtration and Fluid Management, Chromatography including OPUS pre-packed columns, Process Analytics and Proteins, sold to biopharma and CDMOs; Q2 2026 revenue 204 million dollars, up 13 pct organic (2026-07-28). BioLife adds CryoStor biopreservation media for cell therapy, used in 18 approved therapies (2026-07-22).
web_price_volume_mix: Predominantly volume, with mix help. Q2 2026 revenue of 204 million dollars rose 12 pct reported and 13 pct organic, gross margin 53.9 pct and adjusted operating margin 16.7 pct (2026-07-28); management cited order momentum continuing from Q1 2026 and portfolio diversification, not pricing. No evidence of price-led growth or disclosed price increases.
web_bottleneck: Company side is GAAP profitability, with Q2 2026 GAAP operating margin 6.8 pct versus adjusted 16.7 pct (2026-07-28), so amortization and non-GAAP adjustments, SG&A growth and under-used capacity dominate. Customer side it relieves the cell-therapy manufacturing bottleneck by supplying biopreservation media and chromatography consumables that scale production.
web_who_benefits_next: BioLife stockholders receive 11.25 dollars cash plus 0.1442 RGEN shares, 31.00 per share, at closing per SEC 8-K 2026-07-21. Cell-therapy developers and CDMOs get a broader Repligen plus CryoStor supply; Repligen gains APAC reach via its April 2026 China OEM partner; at least 20M dollars of year-one synergies flow to integration and supply-chain partners.
web_who_loses: Larger bioprocessing rivals in filtration, chromatography and process analytics, for example Sartorius, Cytiva and Thermo Fisher, lose relative share as Repligen consolidates cell-processing tools; competing cell-therapy biopreservation media suppliers lose ground to an entrenched CryoStor franchise. Aggregator and context only, not a company disclosure.
web_margin_collapse_risk: GAAP operating margin is already thin at 6.8 pct in Q2 2026 versus 7.6 pct a year earlier (2026-07-28), with SG&A up to 76.6M dollars, a 2.3M dollar contingent-consideration charge, a 13.7M dollar divestiture loss and 5.7M dollars interest. Further mix shift, BioLife integration and inventory step-up costs, or missed synergies would compress margins.
web_low_cost_substitute: Partly. Repligen signed a China OEM partnership, disclosed 2026-05-05, to gain local manufacturing and competitiveness, an admission that lower-cost local supply is a competitive factor. Domestic Chinese chromatography resins, filtration and cell-culture media are the substitutes; how close they are is not found in primary sources.
web_ceo_promised: CEO Olivier Loeillot on 2026-07-28 raised FY26 guidance to 10.5-13.5 pct organic growth and adjusted EPS of 2.03 to 2.09 dollars, from 9-13 pct and 1.97 to 2.05 on 2026-05-05. On 2026-07-22 he promised the BioLife deal would be accretive at least 0.05 dollars year one and 0.25 dollars year two and close in Q4 2026.
web_did_they_deliver: Yes so far on organic targets. Q2 2026 organic growth of 13 pct and adjusted EPS of 0.54 dollars beat the 0.45 dollar consensus, prompting the guidance raise (2026-07-28 SEC 8-K); Q1 2026 delivered 11 pct organic (2026-05-05). BioLife accretion and synergy promises are unproven because the deal has not closed, vote set 2026-10-05.
web_what_would_falsify: BioLife stockholders fail to adopt the merger at the 2026-10-05 special meeting, or the deal lapses at the 2027-01-31 Outside Date; Q3 2026 GAAP operating margin, next estimated 2026-10-27 (aggregator), stays near 6.8 pct with no accretion line of sight; or FY26 organic growth lands below the 10.5 pct low end.
